title: Technical Concept Visualization
summary: A bold, clean poster system built to make edge computing clear for satellite technology audiences.
overview: Simplifying complex technology was the key goal of this project, and the Rise of Virtual Missions poster was the solution. I used a clean, bold aesthetic to communicate Loft's vision for edge computing through satellite technology — transforming satellites into edge computing platforms, no hardware required.
